# first run: Aug 23, 2026 # archive.zip - orig from Zenodo | https://zenodo.org/records/13315719 # renamed to: PlantFormsHabiDistrib.tar.gz
# IMPORTANT REMINDER: I manually hand-massaged the occurrence.tab from Zenodo. I left it with just 2 columns: taxonID and occurrenceID. # : Later on, will create a connector to fix this.
cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/update_resources/connectors
### OK 0of4: This will add a 'genus' column in taxa extension. This is an adjustment for OBISenvDataRecords.tar.gz ### source is: PlantFormsHabiDistrib.tar.gz ### generates: PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed.tar.gz php dwca_update_taxa.php _ '{"source_dwca": "PlantFormsHabiDistrib", "resource_id":"PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed", "resource":"update_taxa"}'
### OK 1of4: This will add higherClassification in taxon.tab and rebuild the DwCA. With carry-over of other extensions. ### source is: FILENAME_taxaFixed.tar.gz ### generates FILENAME-with-hC.tar.gz php dwca_utility.php _ '{"resource_id": "PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed", "task": "gen_hC_using_ancestry"}' #using kingdom phylum class order etc.
### OK 2of4: This use gnparser one name at a time. Not entire file. php run_gnparser_dwca.php _ '{"resource_id": "PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed-with-hC"}' #OK gen neo4j_1
### OK 3of4: Start matching taxa php match_taxa_2DH.php _ '{"resource_id": "PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed-with-hC_neo4j_1", "AncestryIndexVer": "new"}' #OK gen +_eolID
### OK 4of4: Convert taxon.tab, use EOLid value for taxonID. ### REMINDER: Multiple scinames with different taxonIDs have the same canonical thus will have the same EOLid php use_EOLid_as_taxonID.php _ '{"resource_id": "PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed-with-hC_neo4j_1_eolID"}' # gen PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed_finale
php analyze_MoF.php _ '{"resource_id": "PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed_finale"}' #gen PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed_finale_analyzed
### rename cd /var/www/html/eol_php8_code/applications/content_server/resources cp PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed_finale_analyzed.tar.gz PlantFormsHabiDistrib_TraitBank_1_0.tar.gz ls -lt PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed_finale_analyzed.tar.gz ls -lt PlantFormsHabiDistrib_TraitBank_1_0.tar.gz rm -f PlantFormsHabiDistrib_taxaFixed_finale_analyzed.tar.gz
